notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello minions,

Thank you for all your feedback and reports. I had to order those lazy developers to fix and improve some stuff, here’s what they did:

- Fixed electricity VFX when using lightning close to the water.
- Fixed SFXs that kept playing forever under some circumstances.
- Fixed bug that made the ducks' collection appearing partially out of the screen.
- Fixed a bug that prevents you from dying if you lose your last heart just after dashing in some cases.
- Fixed black screen bug after dying against Reniart sometimes.
- Fixed glitch when opening map on ultra wide monitors.
- Fixed a bug that made some bosses and enemies stay still after the player died at the same time as the enemy.
- Fixed a few characters missing in some languages.
- Fixed a wrong translated text in the bathroom tutorial for Chinese and Japanese
- Balanced a few optional bosses.
- Changed golem in the island that appears early in the game for a different enemy that is easier to kill while you still don’t have ice.
- We disabled polish language temporarily while we fix the wrong translations that were reported by players.

Let me know if they did a good work or if a need to punish them harder.

Stay sinister,
Evil Wizard

notes.title: Evil Wizard — Updated Demo Available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Minions,

As you probably know, the original Evil Wizard demo was released back in July 2021th. We received quite a lot of feedback from you guys back then, and we sincerely thank you for that passion!

We took a lot of inspiration from it to implement these changes in the final game, however soon we realized that our demo version doesn't quite look like our final game.

So we updated it!

[h2]INTRODUCING UPDATED EVIL WIZARD EVIL DEMO[/h2]

Ahem

Here's what new content is available now in the updated demo:

[list]
[*] New animations for the dialogues
[*] Save / Load game system
[*] Balance according to demo's feedback
[*] New voice lines
[*] A lot more polished experience overall
[/list]

Try it out now... or else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592100/Evil_Wizard/

notes.title: Evil Update #1: New Features and Development Progress
notes.content:
Hey, minions! His Evilness has graced you with his mighty presence again! 

A lot of good stuff has happened since our last update. I don’t mean "good" as "hero good’" but good as ‘I burnt even more pests, and it smells pretty good here. 

So, what changed? EVERYTHING, MWAHAHAHA!

First of all — now I have a new badass intro cutscene. Since you’ve been a good bunch of minions, I’ll give you a peek: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/d91c29e560204c09b8c37f906c1842f5f3e4d91d.gif[/img]

Pretty epic, right? Wait till you see the full one, hehe. 

My game got lots of new stuff: a brand new main menu, options menu, and new features (yes, yes, yes!) with lots of under the hood improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/8dff4c6d1eb1c24575e9ced5d4e4158910a3bf42.gif[/img]

Amazing, right? This is how everything will look when you launch the game! I wish we could have something with sounds, but that's for another time.

Next are… Options! My minions have a few words about them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/cbf128d8806cb94bb1295e52cf51a0b522c73065.gif[/img]

You'll be able to adjust settings and check the difference in real-time. Even though our sound designer was strongly against the option to lower the volume of the music (and I agree — the anthem of destruction should blast even louder!), but we had to make that sacrifice. 

And lastly… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/98832357689b2ee1d79da8e7d3593f719647aba4.gif[/img]

A very useful and helpful thingy which will recover your HP! Of course, I execute it, in my greatest fashion.

That's it for today! More news to come soon-ish, so stay tuned!

See ya!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592100/Evil_Wizard/

notes.title: Development Update - What Are We Working On
notes.content:
Hello minions! Evil Wizard team here, and we’d like to share an update on our progress with all of you!  Without further ado, let’s begin!

[b]New Tutorial Screen[/b]
We are working on implementing the best tutorial screen for our evil minions! By the orders of the Evil Wizard himself, it should be both “really informative and bonkers cool”. Have a look: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/5bc8e787a024f222f0d825a1eb0d5a8792fb0586.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/82d90b02953ba8ad5d5ad762289470ff484c98f3.png[/img]

Like it? We think we managed pretty well at both aspects, so our designers won’t be burned to crisps any time soon (hopefully). We’d love to hear your thoughts as well! 

[b]New Spells[/b]
With each day, the Evil One becomes more powerful! After all, what kind of wizard can use only one spell (aside from these heroic losers)? Not our “hero” for sure!

While Evil ways are truly limitless, we’ll show only some of his grand powers today. Behold!

[b]Void Spell[/b] is a close-range spell that allows you to sap life away from your enemies! It’s a perfect tool to survive through big encounters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/8f9987fc8ab3f58d1a12ee8868fa444065245cec.gif[/img]

[b]Ice Spell[/b] is a powerful tool to both damage and freeze your enemies in place! These pests really think that their numbers will somehow help them. FOOLS! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/ad012b7dd5bdad6d122022c3820b368773be6fa9.gif[/img]

[b]Earth Spell[/b] is a whole other beast! Imbue yourself with the power of Earth and cast a protective shield that will deflect any incoming attack! This spell will require lots of mana, so use it wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417988/9d9d239965316aa61789974c1edb2b7381eec86d.gif[/img]

Aren't these mind-blowingly cool? His Evilness also loves the new spells we've made for him! More tools for him, more pain for the enemies!

That's all we have for today! Stay tuned for future updates, and remember to wishlist the game! Cheers!
